thread:
Maya (product): Quick announcement: v3.4.1 introduces Delegated Operator Mode for Private/VPC customers. This adds scoped operator identities, an emergency host-operator fallback, and automatic local audit bundle generation.

Maya (product): Important: this is opt-in — current installs are unchanged until customers enable the mode. We ship a migration assistant and a dry-run path to help customers validate before switching.

DeployBot: Rollout started: v3.4.1-delegated-ops -> canary us-east-1 at 3639991300

Ravi (eng): technical note: delegated identities are backed by short-lived certs tied to SSO roles or locally minted keys when SSO is unavailable. We surface cert expiry and rotation hints in the Console.

Leah (security): compliance note: audit bundles include signed operator session metadata + packed logs. For customers requesting SOC2 evidence, we recommend enabling attestations and 90-day rotation for operator keys.

Maya (product): UX for opt-in: toggle in Console or `redwoodctl policies enable-delegated-ops --dry-run` for testing. We also provide a migration assistant CLI that simulates role mappings. No forced migration.

Ravi (eng): fallback behaviour: if delegated auth rejects, we automatically switch to the configured emergency operator for up to the emergency window (configurable). Fallbacks are recorded in the audit bundle and trigger a Console alert.

Sam (sales): Sales ask: is there a short customer blurb I can use?

Maya (product): Customer blurb: "Delegated Operator Mode lets you give your infra teams limited, auditable operator access without sharing long-lived keys. It supports SSO role mapping, automatic audit bundles, and a safe dry-run migration."

DocBot: Docs draft created: /kb/delegated-operator-mode. Includes CLI examples and migration checklist.

Ravi (eng): CLI snippets for KB:
```
# dry-run migration
redwoodctl policies enable-delegated-ops --mode delegated --dry-run

# enable with 48h emergency window and signed bundles
redwoodctl policies set --delegated-ops on --emergency-window 48h --signed-bundles on
```

Leah (security): please include a note about recommended KMS integration and HSM-backed key storage for customers with FIPS requirements.

Maya (product): Will add that to the compliance blurb.

DeployBot: Canary complete at 3639991600, monitoring 2h for error spikes.

Ravi (eng): I'll run the migration checklist against a staging tenant tomorrow and post results here.

Sam (sales): I'll email pilot customers and include the one-paragraph blurb.

Maya (product): Action items: Maya -> publish announcement + compliance blurb; Ravi -> migration runbook + staging run; DocBot -> finalize KB; Leah -> KMS/HSM guidance snippet; Sam -> pilot outreach. Please :thumbsup: when done.
